description:
FILED s518d (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-17) from #3284 (Class-Method-Modifiers t/041-modify-parent.t: ran 1, rc 1).  LOUD (a raw SBCL backtrace -- an untidy error), pre-existing; not minimized.

The file: `do { package MyParent; sub foo {...} package Child; use Class::Method::Modifiers; our @ISA = 'MyParent'; around foo => sub {...} }; Child->foo; is_deeply(...)` (row 1 passes), then a SECOND `do { package MyParent; use Class::Method::Modifiers; around foo => sub {...} }` -- and PCL dies at that top-level form: "FINALIZE-INHERITANCE was called on a forward referenced class: #<sb-mop:forward-referenced-class MyParent::plc-myparent>" (perl: row 2, a TODO row, then done_testing).  A plain re-entry of `package MyParent` with a new sub does NOT reproduce (scratch/s518d/pr/fwd.pl prints 1 2 = perl), so the trigger is Class::Method::Modifiers' install on the PARENT after a child installed through it.
REPRODUCE: tools/run-dist-t.pl ~/.cpan/build/Class-Method-Modifiers-2.15-0 t/041-modify-parent.t.  Next step: minimize (CMM's install_modifier on MyParent: `*{"MyParent::foo"} = ...` / its @ISA reads) and find which CLOS class the runtime creates for MyParent as a forward-referenced superclass of Child that is never defined.
subject: Class-Method-Modifiers 041-modify-parent.t: a second around() on the PARENT package dies with a raw SBCL FINALIZE-INHERITANCE on a forward-referenced class
